rules.description: A battery passport applies to products, not services.
rules.reason: The battery passport applies to a product, not a service.

rules.description: Battery is not placed on the EU market.
rules.reason: Not placed on the EU market or put into service in the EU.

rules.description: For LMT batteries the performance-class label is encouraged; the declaration itself stays mandatory.
rules.reason: LMT batteries: the carbon-footprint performance class is provided where available.

rules.description: Carbon-footprint disclosure covers EV, LMT and industrial batteries above 2 kWh.
rules.reason: Carbon-footprint disclosure applies to EV, LMT and >2 kWh industrial batteries.

rules.description: State-of-health data covers EV, LMT and industrial batteries above 2 kWh.
rules.reason: SoH and lifetime data apply to EV, LMT and >2 kWh industrial batteries.

rules.description: Recycled-content disclosure only applies when the listed metals are present.
rules.reason: The active material does not contain cobalt, nickel, lithium or lead.

rules.description: The due-diligence obligation only applies above the net-turnover threshold.
rules.reason: Below the net-turnover threshold for the supply-chain due-diligence obligation (Art. 48).
